tasks.title: Project Setup & Core Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize project repositories, set up Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, and MongoDB database. Configure basic connections and environment.
tasks.details: Frontend: Next.js with Tailwind CSS. Backend: Python FastAPI. Database: MongoDB. Establish basic project structure and ensure connectivity between components. Implement a basic health check endpoint for the backend.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all services (frontend, backend, database) can start successfully and communicate. Confirm basic API endpoint returns expected response.

tasks.title: User Authentication & Authorization
tasks.description: Implement secure user registration, login, and role-based access control (specialist/patient) using JWT.
tasks.details: Develop API endpoints for user registration and login. Implement JWT token generation upon successful login and validation for protected routes. Ensure role-based access control (specialist vs. patient) is enforced for relevant functionalities.
tasks.testStrategy: Test specialist and patient registration/login flows. Verify that only authenticated users with correct roles can access specific endpoints. Test JWT token expiration and refresh (if applicable).

tasks.title: Specialist - Patient Management & Core Data Entry
tasks.description: Develop backend and frontend functionality for specialists to add, manage, view, and update patient profiles, including treatments, medications, conditions, and consultation notes.
tasks.details: Implement CRUD operations for patient profiles. Allow specialists to add, edit, and delete treatments, medications, and conditions associated with a patient. Enable specialists to write and manage consultation summaries and notes for each patient.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify specialists can create new patient profiles, update existing ones, and delete them. Test adding/editing/deleting treatments, medications, and conditions for patients. Confirm consultation notes can be saved and retrieved.

tasks.title: Patient - Personal Data Access
tasks.description: Enable patients to securely view their assigned specialists, personal medical data (conditions, treatments, medications, consultation history), and receive instructions.
tasks.details: Develop patient-facing UI and backend endpoints to display their assigned specialists. Allow patients to view their personal medical data including conditions, treatments, medications, and consultation history. Implement functionality for patients to receive and view instructions and treatment plans.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify patients can only view their own data and assigned specialists. Test display of all medical history components and instructions. Ensure data integrity and security.

tasks.title: Secure Real-time Messaging & Notifications
tasks.description: Implement end-to-end encrypted real-time chat between patients and specialists, and a notification system for unread messages and appointment changes.
tasks.details: Integrate WebSocket for real-time messaging. Implement end-to-end encryption for all chat communications. Develop a notification system to alert users about new messages and changes in appointment status.
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time message exchange between specialist and patient. Verify message encryption. Test notification delivery for new messages and appointment updates.

tasks.title: Appointment Scheduling & Management
tasks.description: Develop features for specialists to schedule appointments and for patients to request, confirm, and view their appointments with various statuses.
tasks.details: Implement backend APIs for specialists to create, update, and cancel appointments. Develop patient-facing functionality to request, confirm, and view their appointments. Manage appointment statuses: requested, scheduled, confirmed, completed, cancelled.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify specialists can schedule and manage appointments. Test patient's ability to request and confirm appointments. Ensure correct status transitions and visibility for both roles.

tasks.title: Digital Prescriptions & Consultation Summaries
tasks.description: Implement functionality for specialists to generate and manage digital prescriptions, and for patients to view/download them.
tasks.details: Develop specialist interface and backend logic for generating digital prescriptions. Ensure prescriptions can be stored, retrieved, and managed. Enable patients to view and download their assigned prescriptions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify specialists can create valid digital prescriptions. Test patient's ability to view and download their prescriptions. Ensure data integrity and proper linking to patient records.

tasks.title: Compliance & Security Measures
tasks.description: Ensure the application adheres to GDPR and LOPDGDD, including explicit consent, data encryption, role-based access control, data access/modification/deletion rights, HTTPS, and rate limiting.
tasks.details: Implement explicit user consent mechanisms for data handling. Ensure all sensitive health data is encrypted at rest and in transit (HTTPS-only). Enforce strict role-based access control. Provide mechanisms for patients to access, modify, or request deletion of their data. Implement rate limiting and audit logging for security.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct security audits and penetration testing. Verify data encryption. Test consent flows and data access/deletion requests. Confirm rate limiting prevents abuse.

tasks.title: Responsive UI Development
tasks.description: Develop the responsive user interfaces for both specialist and patient roles, including dashboards, real-time chat UI, and an appointment calendar.
tasks.details: Design and implement responsive dashboards tailored for specialists and patients. Build the real-time chat interface. Develop an interactive appointment calendar UI. Ensure consistent styling using Tailwind CSS and responsiveness across various devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure responsiveness. Verify all UI elements are functional and integrate correctly with backend APIs. Conduct user acceptance testing for usability.

tasks.title: AI Assistant Module Development
tasks.description: Design and implement the AI Assistant module for both specialists and patients, providing diagnostic aid and advice based on clinical data and personal history, with interaction logging.
tasks.details: Develop the backend integration with an AI service (e.g., for diagnostic aid, advice generation). Create UI components for AI interaction for both specialist and patient roles. Implement logging of all AI interactions for review and auditing purposes. This task is to be performed post-core functionality completion.
tasks.testStrategy: Test AI assistant's ability to provide relevant suggestions based on provided data. Verify all AI interactions are correctly logged. Test accessibility only when specialist is unavailable (for patient AI).
